scope.completeness: Not an exhaustive visual needs audit. Pattern matches can be false positives and omit image-only content or synonyms. Review each candidate against the source, course context and existing assets; no factual clearance is implied.

sources.export_policy: only ledger tasks with status accepted in learner stages are copied; everything else stays synthetic
sources.handbook_source: See each card source_ref; URLs, pages and printed pages are copied from the accepted export and are not independently verified.
sources.page_number_note: source_ref.pdf_page is the physical PDF page where present; printed_page is the export value. Missing source details remain null or absent.

asset_policy.signs: Use correctly sourced, accurate artwork; verify current authority, state applicability and reuse rights. Do not invent sign appearances.
asset_policy.diagrams: Verify each depicted scenario and rule against official state evidence; do not infer unstated behavior.
asset_policy.accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text; do not rely on color alone.
asset_policy.cross_state: Recheck state applicability and conditions before reusing a visual.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A motorist must not sound the horn at a cyclist ____.
source_cards.back: A motorist must not sound the horn at a cyclist unless danger is imminent.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A cyclist should keep right as far ____.
source_cards.back: A cyclist should keep right as far as safety permits.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A bike box is a designated space at the front of an intersection traffic lane that ____.
source_cards.back: A bike box is a designated space at the front of an intersection traffic lane that makes cyclists visible and assists turning.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A two-way cycle track separates cycling from motor traffic and carries bicycles both ways ____.
source_cards.back: A two-way cycle track separates cycling from motor traffic and carries bicycles both ways along one side of the road.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Passing too close at higher speeds can create air pressure capable of making a cyclist crash, ____.
source_cards.back: Passing too close at higher speeds can create air pressure capable of making a cyclist crash, especially beside a truck or bus.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If a lane cannot safely fit a vehicle and bicycle together, the passing driver must move fully into another ____.
source_cards.back: If a lane cannot safely fit a vehicle and bicycle together, the passing driver must move fully into another lane, even across double yellow lines.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: In an unusually wide lane that safely fits both, a driver may pass a bicycle within the lane only while slowing and maintaining ____.
source_cards.back: In an unusually wide lane that safely fits both, a driver may pass a bicycle within the lane only while slowing and maintaining at least three feet of clearance.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: On a two-lane road, if sight distance or opposing traffic prevents safe bicycle passing, follow at a ____.
source_cards.back: On a two-lane road, if sight distance or opposing traffic prevents safe bicycle passing, follow at a safe gap until passing becomes safe.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: After passing a cyclist, allow ample clearance before moving back right because the ____.
source_cards.back: After passing a cyclist, allow ample clearance before moving back right because the bicycle may be faster than expected.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The detailed bicycle-passing rule allows horn use only to warn ____.
source_cards.back: The detailed bicycle-passing rule allows horn use only to warn of an imminent collision.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Check carefully for cyclists before entering a road or turning, and do not pass a cyclist only to ____.
source_cards.back: Check carefully for cyclists before entering a road or turning, and do not pass a cyclist only to turn immediately across the bicycle’s path.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Before riding in traffic, a cyclist should master straight riding, ____.
source_cards.back: Before riding in traffic, a cyclist should master straight riding, turns and smooth stops.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Cyclists should be prepared to yield to motor vehicles at intersections even ____.
source_cards.back: Cyclists should be prepared to yield to motor vehicles at intersections even when they believe they have priority.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At night, a bicycle requires a white headlamp and red rear reflector; extra reflectors ____.
source_cards.back: At night, a bicycle requires a white headlamp and red rear reflector; extra reflectors and a red taillamp are helpful.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: In an unusually wide lane, a cyclist should ride on its right side to permit safe in-lane passing when ____.
source_cards.back: In an unusually wide lane, a cyclist should ride on its right side to permit safe in-lane passing when the cyclist feels safe doing so.

source_cards.back: A bicycle used at night needs a white headlight visible at five hundred feet.

source_cards.back: A bicycle used at night needs a red rear reflector visible at six hundred feet.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Nighttime bicycle side visibility requires either reflective material visible from both sides at six hundred feet or a lamp visible from ____.
source_cards.back: Nighttime bicycle side visibility requires either reflective material visible from both sides at six hundred feet or a lamp visible from both sides at five hundred feet.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A bicycle taillight ____.
source_cards.back: A bicycle taillight is recommended.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A bicycle rider must sit on or astride ____.
source_cards.back: A bicycle rider must sit on or astride a permanent seat.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A bicycle may carry a passenger only when ____.
source_cards.back: A bicycle may carry a passenger only when designed for one.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A cyclist must not cling to another vehicle ____.
source_cards.back: A cyclist must not cling to another vehicle on the highway.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A cyclist must not ride facing ____.
source_cards.back: A cyclist must not ride facing highway traffic.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A bicycle rider must keep at least one ____.
source_cards.back: A bicycle rider must keep at least one hand on the handlebars.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Cyclists must yield to pedestrians on sidewalks and crosswalks and sound an ____.
source_cards.back: Cyclists must yield to pedestrians on sidewalks and crosswalks and sound an audible warning before passing them.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Cyclists must not use a headset that ____.
source_cards.back: Cyclists must not use a headset that covers both ears.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Every cyclist younger than eighteen must wear a correctly ____.
source_cards.back: Every cyclist younger than eighteen must wear a correctly fitted, fastened bicycle helmet.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A cyclist must stop at a stop sign where the intersecting major road ____.
source_cards.back: A cyclist must stop at a stop sign where the intersecting major road has at least three travel lanes.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A cyclist must stop if a motor vehicle is already stopped at ____.
source_cards.back: A cyclist must stop if a motor vehicle is already stopped at the stop sign the cyclist approaches.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Heavy traffic requiring a stop for safety also requires a cyclist ____.
source_cards.back: Heavy traffic requiring a stop for safety also requires a cyclist to stop at the sign.

source_cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At a minor-road stop sign without a stopped vehicle ahead, a cyclist may slow, yield to vehicles at or approaching the ____.
source_cards.back: At a minor-road stop sign without a stopped vehicle ahead, a cyclist may slow, yield to vehicles at or approaching the intersection, and proceed cautiously without stopping.

source_cards.back: A shared-lane marking reminds motorists and cyclists that both may lawfully use the lane and supports safe positioning and passing.
